metrics.metric: Absolute TSR (PSU awards, modifier as to not negative)

metrics.metric: Relative TSR and absolute TSR (FY 2022 TSR PSU Award)
metrics.evidence: The FY 2022 TSR PSU Award is earned based on our Relative TSR and absolute TSR performance measured over the period of November 1, 2021 through November 3, 2024

metrics.evidence: the achievement of pre-approved metrics and milestones related to corporate strategy, acquisition strategy and leadership development

metrics.metric: Stock price performance milestones ($825, $950, $1,125 average closing price) (FY 2023 PSU Awards)
metrics.evidence: One-third of the shares subject to the FY 2023 PSU Awards will be earned for each per share stock price hurdle attained

metrics.metric: Annual cash incentive corporate goal(s) (APB Plan)
